requirements_summary: Customer needs Dedicated POC that proves: 1) stable p99 latency < 220ms for short-chat flows, 2) throughput 120 reqs/sec with 8k token windows, 3) seamless fallback to Hosted API on capacity or errors, 4) model variant routing (float32 base -> int8 quantized) for cost control, 5) audit logs and KMS integration. Must support SSO and VPC peering. Data residency: US only initially, EU later.
poc_plan: Phase 0: Scope/Sign SOW (1 week) — confirm SLOs, success metrics, SSO details, and VPC/IP ranges
Phase 1: Provision Dedicated pool (2 weeks) — small pool (2 nodes) in us-east, initial model qnt-16b and qnt-7b
Phase 2: Canary (7 days) — 5% traffic to Dedicated, continuous monitoring vs baseline Hosted
Phase 3: Scale & Stress (3 days) — ramp to 50% production-like traffic, measure p50/p95/p99 and token cost
Phase 4: Failover tests (2 days) — simulate node failure and region failover to us-west, validate fallback to Hosted API
Phase 5: Wrap & Decision (1 week) — evaluate quality deltas, cost, and operational runbook; finalize commercial terms
canary_and_fallback_plan: Canary split: start 5% traffic -> 20% -> 50% if metrics stable (24h windows)
Model variants: default route to high-accuracy variant (qnt-16b fp16), cost route to quantized variant (int8/qnt-7b) for low-cost flows
Routing policy: per-endpoint routing rules in Redwood Console; weight-based canary with user-id hashing to maintain sticky sessions
Fallback: on Dedicated error rate >3% OR p99 latency above 300ms for 5min window, auto-fallback to Hosted API; also manual rollback via Console
Region failover: primary us-east -> secondary us-west -> tertiary eu-west; network test steps and DNS TTL adjustments documented
Rollback triggers: degradation in eval set QA score by >2% OR production UAT error growth >4% OR infra instability (node OOMs)
technical_constraints: VPC peering: corporate firewall restricts outbound egress — needs explicit IP allowlist
SSO: SAML 2.0 enforcement + SCIM provisioning required
KMS: bring-your-own-key for model telemetry logs
Logging: must keep audit logs for 13 months (security requirement)
monitoring_and_success_metrics: Latency: p99 < 220ms for chat baseline; p95 < 150ms
Errors: total error rate < 0.5% during steady state
Quality: eval-set BLEU/ROUGE-like quality delta < 1.5% vs Hosted baseline
Cost: token unit cost delta target <= 10% above Hosted for same latency performance
Operational: successful auto-fallback tested twice without user impact
pricing_discussion: Customer requested a 90-day trial price for Dedicated pool at a reduced commit level. Interested in monthly reserved with a 3-month ramp allowance. Need to present two options: (A) low-commit (discounted for POC) with higher per-token overage, (B) annual commit with lower unit costs. Procurement prefers option A for Q2 approval.
